scope: Synthetic in-memory SQLite; same existing migrations; no added indexes, network, application services, credentials or production data.
limitation: VM instructions are not D1 billed rows, end-to-end latency or a daily capacity measurement. Old or never-notified recipients can still scan a full incident ledger without a composite delivery index. Actual hosted D1 budget remains unmeasured while paused.
baseline_query: SELECT created_at FROM alert_deliveries WHERE incident_id=? AND rule_id=? AND state='eligible_ui' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
current_query:
SELECT d.created_at,d.state,d.incident_version,d.rule_version,
      coalesce(v.view,i.view) AS delivered_view
     FROM alert_deliveries d
     LEFT JOIN incident_revisions v ON v.incident_id=d.incident_id AND v.version=d.incident_version
     LEFT JOIN incidents i ON i.id=d.incident_id AND i.version=d.incident_version AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
     WHERE d.incident_id=? AND d.rule_id=? AND d.state='eligible_ui'
     ORDER BY d.incident_version DESC,d.rule_version DESC LIMIT 1
